title: mris_fwhm
description: Smooths surface data and/or estimates FWHM

subject.description: Subject whose surface the input is defined on.
subject.title: Subject

hemi.description: Hemifield that the input is defined on. Legal values are lh and rh.
hemi.title: Hemisphere

surf.description: Surface name to compute AR1 on. Default is white.
surf.title: Surface

label_file.description: Label file to be used as a mask.
label_file.title: Label File

mask_file.description: Mask file. Compute AR1 only over voxels in the given mask.
mask_file.title: Mask File

x_matrix.description: Detrend data with the matrix in x.mat.
x_matrix.title: Detrending Matrix

sqr_flag.description: Compute square of input before smoothing.
sqr_flag.title: Square Input Flag

ar1vol.description: Save spatial AR1 as an overlay.
ar1vol.title: AR1 Volume

fwhmmap.description: Save vertex-wise spatial FWHM as an overlay.
fwhmmap.title: FWHM Map

prune_flag.description: Remove any voxel that is zero in any subject (after any inversion).
prune_flag.title: Prune Flag

out_mask.description: File to save the final mask.
out_mask.title: Out Mask

varnorm_flag.description: Normalize the variance across space within any mask.
varnorm_flag.title: Variance Normalize Flag

fwhm.description: Smooth input by the specified FWHM in mm.
fwhm.title: FWHM Value

niters_only.description: File that reports the number of iterations needed to achieve the specified FWHM.
niters_only.title: Niters Only

output_file.description: Output file to save the processed data.
output_file.title: Output File

synth_flag.description: Synthesize input with white gaussian noise.
synth_flag.title: Synthesize Input Flag

synth_frames.description: Number of frames for synthesized input.
synth_frames.title: Number of Synth Frames

checkopts_flag.description: Don't run anything, just check options and exit.
checkopts_flag.title: Check Options Flag
